ownership.required_owner: current IndirectAccess/Tables owner after explicit transfer
ownership.admission_owner: one indirect unit from validated B word through terminal completion
forbidden: reusing a generation before terminal drain

order: validate integer width and B index range
translate A target and export physical mapping
reserve all required finite slots atomically
admission.malformed_action: TERMINAL_ERROR before any policy mutation for that word
admission.capacity_action: stop scan, drain issued work and responses, reset finite tables, retry same validated word

issue.within_slice: native first valid row slot, same-grow row slots, then valid line slots in slot order
issue.response_reservation: reserve one generation-tagged response slot and exact Offset-chain word count before request creation
issue.line_chain_limit: drain before a line chain would exceed 480 words

completion.response_match: all request identity fields must match a live reservation
completion.placement: each Offset iteration receives exactly one returned word at its recorded wid
completion.release: release Offset chain, response words, and response slot only after response consumption
completion.partition_advance: allowed only with zero live Offset/row/line entries, zero response reservations, and zero pending writes
completion.operation_complete: allowed only after partition 3, exact logical placement count, exact output oracle, and all ownership counts are zero
completion.error_drain: reject new work, retain generation ownership until every accepted request is retired, then enter TERMINAL_ERROR

required_trace.fail_closed: missing, duplicate, inconsistent, or unhashed fields invalidate the screen

gate_order: physical A request and per-slice row-transition comparison
simTicks only after all prior gates
